versions.subject: rule: process dumping lolbins
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image|endswith: '\rdrleakdiag.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/fullmemdmp'
selection2:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - '/fullmemdmp'
        - ' /o '
        - ' /p '
condition: selection1 or selection2

versions.subject: Added detection to detect every possible way of execution through rdrleakdiag
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rdrleakdiag.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'fullmemdmp'
selection_cli_output:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -o '
        - ' /o '
selection_cli_process:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - ' -p '
        - ' /p '
selection_cli_memdmp:
     CommandLine|contains:
        - '-fullmemdmp'
        - '/fullmemdmp'
condition: selection_img or (all of selection_cli_*)
versions.spl: (Image="*\\rdrleakdiag.exe" CommandLine="*fullmemdmp*") OR (CommandLine IN ("* -o *", "* /o *") CommandLine IN ("* -p *", "* /p *") CommandLine IN ("*-fullmemdmp*", "*/fullmemdmp*"))
